name: Frisians
alt: Frisian lands east of the Lauwers

predecessors.name: Kingdom of the Franks
predecessors.text: 'the area east of the Lauwers', held by the Franks since 785 and drawn as Frankish by Cliopatria in 788-792

successors.name: Kingdom of the Franks
successors.text: the same 33 cells, Frankish again from 800 in Cliopatria

ledger.x: 793: Cliopatria draws the Frisian land east of the Lauwers as its own row.
799: Cliopatria's Frisians row ends and its Frankish shape holds the land again from 800.

wars.name: Frankish conquest of Frisia
wars.outcome: The Franks defeated the Frisians at the Boarn in 734 ('the Frankish Empire eventually subjugated Frisia in 734') and 'Frankish troops conquered the area east of the Lauwers in 785, after Charlemagne defeated the Saxon leader Widukind'.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary; the Lauwers is the only line named, as the old west limit of the land.
